title: WAEC SSCE General Mathematics / Mathematics (Core) - Detailed Syllabus

contents: Conversion of numbers from one base to another

contents: Laws of indices

Use of tables of logarithms and antilogarithms

contents: Patterns of sequences
Arithmetic Progression (A.P.)

contents: Simple statements. True and false statements. Negation of statements, implications

contents: Ratio between two similar quantities
